patterns.note: Sections alternate between full-width dark backgrounds and light content-constrained areas, often employing a split-screen layout for text and imagery.
Headings use a large, elegant serif font with key words often italicized, contrasted with a clean sans-serif for body text and labels.
A high-contrast palette features deep charcoal backgrounds paired with bright lime green accents for CTAs and interactive elements.
The hero section features a video background with a subtle parallax effect as the user scrolls, while subsequent content sections reveal with a gentle fade-up animation upon entering the viewport.
A prominent trust bar featuring partner logos is integrated directly below the hero, establishing credibility early in the user journey.

technique_notes: A full-bleed video hero background is used, with a dark overlay to ensure text legibility, and a subtle parallax effect on the background element as the user scrolls.
Content sections are revealed using scroll-triggered animations, where elements gently fade and slide upwards as they enter the viewport.
A sticky navigation bar remains at the top, maintaining brand presence and access to key actions.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant serif headings (~3-4x body) with a generous line height, complemented by a clean, legible sans-serif for body text and smaller labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (e.g., ~8-12px) are applied to buttons, cards, and the overall page container, softening the aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with ample vertical padding between sections and generous internal spacing within content blocks, especially in the hero.

standout: The site stands out with its sophisticated blend of a deep, almost black, background and a vibrant lime green accent, creating a luxurious yet modern feel. The elegant serif typography for headings, often with italicized keywords, further elevates the brand's perceived authority and distinctiveness.
